title: Petal mark v1
description: What tells one organisation on the map from another: its name, its token's symbol and its logo, each with where it came from (the chain first, then curated lists). One per map, named by the map's address. Each part says whether the thing declared it itself (self-declared), a curated list holds it (verified), or Petals worked it out (inferred).

about.description: the map it marks, by its address: chain:address, or chain:population for a whole network (the map card's id)

name.description: the organisation's name, or null when nothing names it beyond the map's own name

logo.description: its logo, kept by Petals as a picture named by its sha256, or null

status.description: self-declared: the contract, the DAO or the account says it of itself. verified: a curated list holds this address (verified_by names which). inferred: Petals worked it out (ref says how).

source.description: where it came from, in a word: chain, poster, daohaus, metaplex, ft_metadata, trustwallet, uniswap, coingecko, cow, superchain, arbitrum, jupiter, defillama, petals

ref.description: exactly where: the call it answered (symbol() on eip155:1:0x…), or the list and its version, or the page

verified_by.description: the curated lists that hold this address, each with its version: what makes a self-declared value verified

ref.description: the address it was read from
